parole.testo: Unknown, with little consensus among proposals. Most likely is from earlier Classical Persian خدابان (xudābān) ~ Early New Persian خذابان (xuḏābān), a locality in medieval Herat which was famous for its wide avenues. Some analyze as خی (xī /xi, “waterskin”) + آب (āb /âb, “water”) + ـان (-ān /-ân). C
